exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Pull toward eye level and rotate the hands apart.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Brace firmly and use the depth you can control.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Keep the hips against the pad and avoid locking the knees.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Push the hips back while keeping the weight close to the legs.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Pause briefly in the contracted position.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Keep shoulder blades retracted and use a controlled descent.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Use a neutral grip if that feels better on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Use a full stretch and pause at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Avoid bouncing at the bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: Standing Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Brace before each rep and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Lead with the elbows and stop near shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.notes: Keep the upper arms still throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
exercises.notes: Choose assistance that allows smooth, controlled repetitions.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull the elbows toward the ribs without swinging.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up
exercises.notes: Begin each rep from a controlled hang.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Avoid using momentum from the hips.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Keep a neutral grip and control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.notes: Keep the torso quiet and finish with the elbows behind you.
